prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE highly refined NORMAL RECTILINEAR architectural interior photo in landscape3:2, output2048x1360 or largest available. Input1: current apartment360 panorama is GEOMETRY/ADJACENCY evidence ONLY, NOT output projection. Keep the existing floor plan, original doors/windows and all previously approved functional layouts. DO NOT output360/equirectangular/fisheye, a collage, curved walls, a board of samples, an exterior or a close-up that loses the room. Correct straight verticals and a real28-32mm architectural lens, plausible small-apartment proportions. Every visible edge, reveal, textile seam and fixture must look built, not generic CGI: fine open wood grain at realistic scale, tiny eased edge, satin non-plastic metal, actual separate fabric weave, coherent tiled joints, properly supported shelves, meaningful surface contact shadows. Natural soft NEUTRAL daylight plus just a few local warm task pools; readable white balance, no overall yellow/orange haze, HDR halos or artificial blur. No people, text, visible brand logos, watermarks or cloned botanical art everywhere. This is an original home design informed by published general design principles, not a reproduction of a designer's named project. THE USER EXPLICITLY WANTS INTENTIONAL OBJECT PLACEMENT AND SMALL LIVED-IN DECORATIONS: do not make an empty showroom. Group useful small personal items around actual daily activities, harmonize material/colour/height and leave working surfaces free. Don't randomly scatter repetitive props.
STYLE: pale natural honey oak edge with chalky white surfaces, sage and oatmeal fine ticking stripes, restrained blush/terracotta accent, pale mineral wall, fresh grouped foliage, bright neutral daylight
LEARNED DESIGN PRIORITIES: Keep the reference home's wood-edge WHITE coffee table, green/oatmeal TICKING STRIPE sofa/bedding and window plant grouping. Make built-ins precise with thin real wood edge-banding, quiet reveals, aligned shelf brackets, small rounded corners and a recessed timber toe kick. Restrained subtle sage niche or cabinet face, a small handmade ceramic backsplash detail, one paper/opal task lamp. Replace crowded generic plant/flower/poster arrangements with three intentional heights at existing window. White surface stays matte and clean, no fake yellow sunwash, thick jungle plants on every shelf or huge rope patterns.
EXACT LAYOUT: Original dining bay,1.20x.70m table, WEST bench and two individual chairs at NORTH and SOUTH table ends, EAST passage roughly.90m stays empty.1.50m coffee counter along original wall, original windows/doorways. Visible kitchen:2.30m north counter, northeast fridge, .85m east auxiliary, two TOP-HUNG clear glass banks OPEN and compactly stacked at ends, no floor rail or corner post, no island.
VISIBLE IMPROVEMENTS: Refine table edge thickness, believable chair-to-table proportion, wood joinery and bench seat cushion, coffee-machine/grinder tray, four carefully spaced cups, credible small under-shelf work light, actual electrical sockets and concealed wire route. Quiet washable backsplash behind coffee surface, closed bottom storage, a real pendant centered on table not floating randomly.
LIVED-IN STYLING: LIVED-IN STYLING: coffee machine and grinder together on one fitted washable tray, THREE practical cups grouped on rail/shelf within hand reach, one folded tea towel, a small handwritten-style note/postcard board WITHOUT readable lettering next to coffee corner; keep machine lid working and sockets reachable. Dining table has a modest linen runner, low fruit/ceramic bowl and two daily cups, at least half tabletop empty; one small framed personal print and low bud vase on sideboard only. Every object belongs to coffee or eating ritual, varied heights, not scattered matching flower vases and fake potted plants.
CAMERA: Eye1.35m normal rectilinear28-32mm photo across table and coffee counter with kitchen opening readable, straight verticals, no panoramic wrapping.
